name: Notifications hub
description: A deterministic fetcher (no model): GitHub notifications, and Gmail, Jira and Slack behind the same shape, become one note each on a notifications page, with a board by read state and one by source.

page.description: The page the notifications land under (default notifications)

outline.description: Another outline on this host to write in (default the one it runs for)

days.description: How far back the first pull of a source looks (default 14)

fixtures.description: Source name to a JSON file (relative to this folder) of made-up notifications read instead of the real service

actions.label: Pull notifications
actions.description: Fetches each source's notifications changed since its last pull: a new one becomes a note, a changed one is updated, one read at the source is marked read here; one you marked read stays read
